newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Thai housing bank to launch FRN in early London.
newsitem.headline: Thai housing bank to launch FRN in early London.

text.p: Thailand's Government Housing Bank will launch a US$200 million floating rate note issue during early London trading hours today, lead manager Deutsche Morgan Grenfell said Thursday.
The five-year notes will pay a coupon equivalent to the six-month London Interbank Offered Rate.
They will be priced and re-offered at 99.65 to give a re-offer yield of LIBOR plus eight basis points.
The issue is fully guaranteed by the Kingdom of Thailand, which is rated Single-A by Standard and Poor's Corp and A2 by Moody's Investors Service.
The note is a replacement issue for a Kingdom of Thailand sovereign issue that was mandated to Deutsche Morgan Grenfell in June. The issue would have been Thailand's first Euro-FRN.
Bankers said Thailand had planned to onlend proceeds of the issue to Government Housing Bank.
But they said Thai officials now are encouraging government entities to borrow in international markets in their own names rather than through the central government.
Government Housing Bank provides low-interest loans to house buyers. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843-6371
